title: Wire the full catalogue and arbitrary types through the UI
acceptance_criteria: A fresh app seeds the complete 20-record catalogue and never seeds the deleted three-record PoC.
Exercise cards, details, add-exercise controls, type filters, routine-group controls, and routine selections display and accept arbitrary type values without assuming only Strength and Stretch.
Exercises with multiple type values are discoverable through each matching type and display their values without lossy coercion.
UI state, storage writes, favorites, routine generation, and saved snapshots remain usable after selecting arbitrary or multi-valued types.
The user-facing UI does not expose evidence or source fields as Exercise model properties.
completion_summary: Wired the full catalogue UI with dynamic multi-type filters, arbitrary type entry, multi-value display, and dynamic routine controls.
